title: List all female SLE patients treated as outpatients who had abnormal white
question: List all female SLE patients treated as outpatients who had abnormal white blood cell counts (WBC < 3.5 or WBC > 9.0) in any laboratory test conducted between 1990 and 1996. For each qualifying lab record, return the patient ID, sex, diagnosis, lab test date, and WBC value, sorted by patient ID and date.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T1."XCL_064", T2."XCL_015", T2."XCL_030"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND (T2."XCL_030" < 3.5 OR T2."XCL_030" > 9.0)
  AND T2."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
ORDER BY T1."XCL_058" ASC, T2."XCL_015" ASC
